text: How does this reach you? March 2024 Paper 22 used prostaglandins in inflammation. Prostaglandins are released by cells or transported to target cells, then bind to receptors on their surface membranes. Those are two marking points; release and transport share one. A full outline still names all three stages. The scheme does not need our insulin example; that is beyond the mark scheme. November 2022 asked why different cell types respond to L L thirty-seven: shared complementary receptors. For that question, use binding site for the receptor. And our hormone does not search: blood carries it widely, and complementary receptors determine which cells respond.
